datasetMetadata.name: Voice Arena Private Held-Out Benchmark Corpus (VA-Eval-60)
datasetMetadata.antiContaminationPolicy: Private offline corpus collected under zero-leakage protocol. Not included in any public training set (CommonVoice, LibriSpeech, VoxCeleb, AMI, DIHARD).

domains.name: Meeting
domains.acousticEnvironment: Acoustically variable meeting rooms, glass conference spaces, open team spaces
domains.description: Multi-party project planning and technical syncs with frequent interruptions, backchannels ('yeah', 'right'), and unconstrained floor transitions.

domains.name: Phone Call (8kHz)
domains.acousticEnvironment: Telephony bandpass filtered (300Hz–3.4kHz & 8kHz AMR), variable network jitter
domains.description: Customer support and financial service interactions with asymmetric audio channels, speaker echo, and line static.

domains.name: Podcast / Interview
domains.acousticEnvironment: Treated studio with low reverberation, high dynamic range, expressive vocal timber
domains.description: In-depth conversational interviews, tech roundtables, and debates recorded with professional studio proximity.

domains.name: Medical
domains.acousticEnvironment: Examining rooms, clinic ambulatory settings with light HVAC and medical equipment hum
domains.description: Doctor-patient consultations and nursing handoffs containing delicate backchannels, pauses, and technical pharmaceutical discourse.

domains.name: Noisy Room
domains.acousticEnvironment: Active cafeteria, open coffee shop, collaborative co-working hub (SNR 5–15 dB)
domains.description: Stress-testing recordings where background babble, espresso machines, and keyboard tapping challenge speech activity detection.

annotationProtocol.pass1: Primary trained phonetician segments active speech turns and flags candidate speaker boundaries using continuous time alignment.
annotationProtocol.pass2: Secondary annotator independently labels a random 20% stratified subset blind to Pass 1.
annotationProtocol.adjudication: Senior speech scientist reviews segments where Inter-Annotator disagreement exceeds 150ms collar or speaker identity deviates.
annotationProtocol.iaaScore: 3.12% DER between independent human annotators at 0.0s collar (human ceiling baseline).
